notes.title: Patch Notes - Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
- Controller Inputs now display corectly.

- Change NPC name to fit the character.

- Intro text spell correction.

- Fixed sprite rendering bug.

- You can now attack an move in a smoother way.

- Fixed camera bug in level 3.

- Fixed an issue where you could get stuck on a platform in level 5.
